summary: JRPG where you fight alongside summoned heroes!
description:
Revyse, a young man learning Summoning under Master Volgrim,
encounters Aurora, a girl who has lost her memory.

Beyond the pursuit awaits trials and encounters.
Harness the awakened power of Summoning and confront formidable enemies—

◆ Summoning & Arrange System
Revyse, having awakened to the power of Summoning, can use Echostones to summon heroes from another world.
Recruit powerful allies and fight together.

With up to 8 members possessing unique abilities and skills, strategically form a party of 4 to challenge dungeons.

◆ Combat & Command Battles
Carefully choose your actions in turn-based command battles.
Since enemy actions are predicted, adapting accordingly is key.

Additionally, members can be swapped mid-battle.
Exploit character affinities to gain an advantage.

◆ Other Systems
[Exploration]
Explore dungeons and discover treasure chests containing equipment and gold.

[Trade]
If battles become tough, gather money and purchase the latest equipment.

[Retreat]
Retreating is one way when you encounter a powerful opponent.
